default_storm.why: Jackson Roofing is based in Plano, so the default storm is the most relevant recent hail day for PLANO homes. Aug 12, 2025 (14 months ago, inside the usual 2-year Texas claim window) put 1 inch+ radar hail (NOAA MRMS MESH) on 2,224 Plano homes (5,384 at 0.75 in+), radar max 1.09 in; no NWS spotter report was filed in Plano that day, so it is radar-only. Jun 2, 2026 is newer but reached only 312 Plano homes at 1 in+ (max 1.03 in). Sep 24, 2024 hit Plano far harder (11,110 homes at 1 in+, 5,469 at 1.5 in+, max 2.49 in, NWS reports to 2.0 in) but is now just over two years old, past most policies' claim window.

source: Collin CAD 2026 roll (CCAD Parcel Feature Set) + Denton CAD 2026 roll (TxGIO StratMap) + Dallas CAD 2026 data files (on StratMap parcel shapes) + Rockwall CAD roll (TxGIO StratMap 2026 + City of Rockwall GIS), Overture building outlines, NOAA MRMS MESH hail, NWS FWD local storm reports, Collin CAD Roof/Re-Roof permits, USGS 3DEP 2018 lidar pitch
